title: The Sharp Debt
author: Vesper Almeida
blurb: Dominic Fairweather, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
